notes: Signal files are not used for fitting the background density.
max_btag_csvv2/btag_wp_medium are excluded because Delphes signal semantics are not continuous CSVv2-like HTMHT semantics.
n_vertices/rho are excluded because signal generation lacks true pileup overlay while HTMHT data carries real pileup conditions.
NaNs for optional extra-jet eta/dphi features are mapped to an explicit out-of-range sentinel, not median-imputed into the physical continuum.
Set DROP_EXTRA_JET_FEATURES=1 for the audit ablation that removes the six padded extra-jet columns from the continuous density model.
